retained_attempts.finding: A reconciliation aggregate reused an annotation alias as the aggregate name, causing a PostgreSQL undefined-column error
retained_attempts.resolution: Use a distinct has_match annotation; targeted and complete suites pass

retained_attempts.finding: An old cash HTTP fixture omitted the now-required evidence; two new fixtures reused an occupied appointment slot
retained_attempts.resolution: Provide explicit synthetic evidence and use a separate partial receipt against the same bill; existing rules remain

retained_attempts.finding: Docker default network pools exhausted before the new application containers started
retained_attempts.resolution: Verify no overlap and use a private explicit subnet for this rehearsal; retain all existing projects, networks and data volumes

retained_attempts.finding: Default network pools exhausted before verification containers/tests started
retained_attempts.resolution: After successful full encrypted restore, remove only this completed rehearsal runtime and networks without volumes; retain the failed log and rerun the complete gate. Existing Mac/historical projects unchanged

retained_attempts.finding: A CSV attachment was treated as a navigable page
retained_attempts.resolution: Inspect the authenticated download response; retain the failed probe and repeat; no application change

retained_attempts.finding: macOS native popup options were not driven by Chrome automation; a separate keyboard state-change confirmation saved successfully before the immediate DOM probe saw the redirected page
retained_attempts.resolution: Record the native-menu limitation; retain the committed attempt and verify the saved state without resubmission; keyboard Tab/Enter/Space preview and explicit confirmation completed
